test_drop_duplicates: test the Series.drop_duplicates method with various numpy dtypes and keep parameter values
test_drop_duplicates_bool: test the Series.drop_duplicates method with boolean dtype and all keep parameter options
test_drop_duplicates_no_duplicates: test the Series.drop_duplicates method when the series contains no duplicate values
test_drop_duplicates_categorical: test the Series.drop_duplicates method on Categorical Series with unused categories and keep options
test_drop_duplicates_ignore_index: test the Series.drop_duplicates method with ignore_index=True to reset the resulting index
